newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche, Hochtief to pool Holzmann shares - report.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche, Hochtief to pool Holzmann shares - report.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Bank AG and construction group Hochtief AG plan to pool their stake in construction group Philipp Holzmann AG, a German newspaper reported on Sunday.

The Sueddeutschen Zeitung said a decision on the pooling of shares in Holzmann, which would need approval from European competition authorities, could come from Deutsche's supervisory board as soon as this week.

Deutsche and Hochtief, which has been seeking to acquire Holzmann for some time, would together have almost 50 percent of Holzmann's shares. Deutsche owns 25.8 percent of Holzmann while Hochtief has a 20 percent stake.
Spokesmen for Deutsche and Hochtief could not immediately be reached for comment. But Deutsche last week rejected another report saying it planned to pool its shares with Hochtief.
The aim of such a pooling arrangement would be to allow Hochtief to extend its management influence over Holzmann.
The reports have come as a German appeals court is due to start from April 9 hearings as to whether Hochtief should be allowed to further expand its stake.
German cartel authorities earlier vetoed a plan under which Hochtief would raise its stake to 35 percent.
